notes.observation: System pressure gauge showing approximately 2800-3000 PSI during ground check. Seems lower than expected but within limits per OM-S7-001 Rev A. Need to verify if newer pressure spec applies to this S/N.
notes.action: Monitored pressure for 30 minutes, stable at 2950 PSI. Acceptable per current maintenance manual.

notes.observation: Noted slight delay in actuator response during functional check. Response time measured at approximately 10ms. The spec says 8ms max but the old SV-4200 valves are known to be slower. This aircraft hasn't been upgraded to SV-4200A yet.
notes.action: Logged discrepancy report DR-2024-0147. Recommended scheduling SV-4200A upgrade per ECN-2847 at next depot visit.

notes.observation: Fluid temp running a bit warm after extended ground ops, saw about 95°C on the HMI display. The heat exchanger (HX-3300) seems to be working but ground cooling is always worse than in flight.
notes.action: No action required. Temperature within limits. Noted for trend monitoring.

notes.observation: Bypass indicator popped during engine start. Cleared after warmup. Probably just cold fluid viscosity issue - it was about -15°C ambient.
notes.action: Replaced filter element as precautionary measure. New element P/N FE-2100-10A installed. Reset bypass indicator.

general_remarks: Overall system in good condition for an aircraft with 3,200 flight hours. The main hydraulic ram (that's what the old-timers call the PA-7100) is still performing well. Recommend upgrading servo valve at next opportunity.
